svg.aria-label: Eight concentric Platonic and Archimedean hull shells recovered from the E8 to H4 fold projection, shown as small multiples ordered by radius
svg.title: E8 → H4 fold: 8 concentric Platonic/Archimedean hulls
svg.desc: The 240 E8 roots, folded to 3D via the H4 unimodular fold and ST-axis drop, split into 8 concentric shells of sizes {4, 24, 24, 30, 30, 40, 40, 48}. Each panel is one shell's own vertex/edge structure (z-axis dropped for display), independently scaled to fill its cell. Generated deterministically by scripts/generate-gallery.ts from getE8PlatonicHulls.
svg.text: E8 → H4 fold: 8 concentric Platonic/Archimedean hulls
